verdict.rationale: AgentMail's docs describe scoped API keys that can be limited to a single pod or a single inbox. A separate Permissions feature restricts what an API key can do, so least-privilege credentials for an agent are a first-party capability. missing for 10: details of the specific permission actions/granularity and how keys are issued or revoked, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Scoped API keys restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox.
`Permissions` let you restrict what an API key can do.
create a Pod per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.
